long_biography.plain_text:
After Ole Kirk Christiansen's toy business created the family's wealth, ownership passed to his son Godtfred and then to Godtfred's children, Kjeld and Gunhild. A 2007 demerger left Kjeld with KIRKBI and Gunhild with the new Kirk Kapital, separating Anders Kirk Johansen's investment branch from current LEGO ownership.

Gunhild brought Anders and his brothers into equal ownership and transferred her remaining stake in 2019. Johansen now combines a substantial Kirk Kapital shareholding and board seat with direct control of A. Kirk companies. Kirk Kapital takes active minority positions in Scandinavian businesses and manages diversified financial portfolios. His separate group includes property, agriculture, industrial holdings and the automotive venue My Garage.
